record.name: Freshdesk
record.one_liner: Freshdesk is a cloud-based customer support platform that provides ticketing, helpdesk solutions, and customer service automation.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free trial or account and obtain an API key directly from their profile settings.
record.api_note: The REST API covers tickets, contacts, companies, solutions, SLAs, business hours, and more.
